2607.05031.title: LLM-Based Test Oracles: Source-of-Authority Taxonomy -- A Systematic Literature Review
2607.05031.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to produce test oracles, the part of a test that decides whether observed behavior is correct. Yet a clear account of where these oracles draw their authority is missing. Prior secondary studies organize the area by oracle form or by LLM technique. None organizes it by the source of the verdict's authority, the property that governs how far a verdict can be trusted. This article presents a systematic literature review, conducted and reported under the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. From 2,436 records, an LLM pre-filter followed by independent dual human screening (reviewer agreement, a Cohen's kappa of 0.79) and full-text assessment yielded 54 included studies. We analyze these along three axes: the source of an oracle's authority, the form it takes, and the mechanism that adjudicates it. We characterize the landscape of domains, languages, models, and adaptation strategies. Specification-derived authority, though the most common single source, covers about half of the studies (28 of 54). The remaining 26 reach a verdict with no specification at all. The source of authority and the adjudication mechanism cross-cut: the same source is checked by several mechanisms and one mechanism serves several sources, so a label such as LLM-as-a-judge names a mechanism rather than a basis for trust. We further report how these oracles are evaluated and how they fail, and read the sparse and empty regions of the taxonomy as a research agenda. The protocol, search query, and per-study coding sheet are released as supplementary material.
2607.05031.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被用來生成測試預言，這是測試的一部分，用來決定觀察到的行為是否正確。<lb/>然而，缺乏對這些預言來源的權威性的明確說明。<lb/>先前的次級研究是根據預言的形式或LLM技術來組織這一領域。<lb/>沒有一個是根據判決權威的來源來組織的，這是決定判決可信度的屬性。<lb/>本文呈現了一項系統的文獻回顧，根據PRISMA 2020指南進行和報告。<lb/>從2,436條記錄中，經過LLM預篩選，然後進行獨立的雙人篩查（評審一致性，Cohen's kappa為0.79）和全文評估，最終納入54項研究。<lb/>我們沿著三個軸線分析這些研究：預言的權威來源、其形式以及裁決機制。<lb/>我們描述了領域、語言、模型和適應策略的全景。<lb/>雖然源自規範的權威是最常見的單一來源，但僅涵蓋約一半的研究（54項中的28項）。<lb/>其餘26項則在沒有任何規範的情況下達成判決。<lb/>權威來源和裁決機制相互交叉：相同的來源由多個機制檢查，而一個機制服務於多個來源，因此像LLM作為裁判這樣的標籤指的是一種機制，而不是信任的基礎。<lb/>我們進一步報告這些預言是如何被評估的以及它們如何失敗，並將分類法中稀疏和空白的區域解讀為研究議程。<lb/>該協議、搜索查詢和每項研究的編碼表作為補充材料發布。
